appraisal_events.evidence: Mme de Guermantes n'est pas un aigle, mais elle n'est tout de même pas stupide.
appraisal_events.explanation: Saint-Loup gives a mixed, offhand assessment of the duchess's intelligence: denying she is brilliant while affirming she is not stupid.

ambiguities: The narrator's successful extraction of a promise from Saint-Loup to speak well of him to Mme de Guermantes could be read as a gain in emotional leverage for le narrateur as a scene participant, but the passage frames this mainly through his own retrospective admission of anxiety and lying (dissimuler le mensonge), which reads as self-critical commentary rather than a staged external social outcome, so le narrateur was not scored.
